newsitem.title: JAPAN: Gajoen Kanko to hold 1000 GMT briefing.
newsitem.headline: Gajoen Kanko to hold 1000 GMT briefing.

text.p: Japanese hotel operator Gajoen Kanko KK said it would hold a news conference at 7 p.m. (1000 GMT).
Company officials were not available for comment on the details of the planned news conference.

The Tokyo Stock Exchange suspended trading in the company's shares for the whole day on Monday due to unclear details on tax-related issues. Local media reports at the weekend said the hotel operator had unpaid taxes amounting to 10 billion yen.
